applicableAreas: Transformer pads with clearances less than 5 feet to buildings
findings.comment: No reduced clearances (3 feet) are shown on plans, and no Austin Energy Design written approval documents are provided in the application. If any 3-foot clearances exist, verification of approval, 3-hour fire rating, confined space assessment, window/door clearances, and vertical clearances would be required but cannot be verified from submitted documents.

applicableAreas: Buildings adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Building elevation drawings are not provided in the site plan package. Cannot verify whether windows, doors, or ventilating ducts exist on building facades adjacent to transformer pads, whether any are less than 12 feet from grade, or whether lateral separation requirements (5 feet for masonry, 12 feet for non-masonry oil-filled equipment) are met.

applicableAreas: Buildings with stairwell locations
findings.comment: Building floor plans showing stairwell locations are not provided. Cannot verify whether emergency stairwells or exit stairs serve as fire exits and are adjacent to transformer pads, or confirm minimum clearances if applicable.

applicableAreas: If fire escapes present near transformers
findings.comment: No fire escape structures are shown on the site plan or fire protection plan. Building elevations are not provided to confirm whether external fire escapes exist. Cannot verify fire escape locations or 20-foot radial clearance requirement from oil-filled transformers if applicable.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad access areas
findings.comment: Transformer access door orientation and hot-stick use clearance areas are not documented on the electrical plan. Without access door direction specifications, cannot verify minimum 10-foot clearance to open areas or adjacent buildings/structures from the access door side of each pad.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads if located in confined spaces
findings.comment: No transformer locations are within enclosed areas or niches, but cross-section drawings showing vertical clearance through access paths are not provided. If any access paths are constrained by parking garages, overhangs, or enclosed areas, 15-foot vertical clearance documentation would be required but is absent.

applicableAreas: Trees near transformer pads and overhead electric distribution
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows tree locations and symbols (SY, PL, M, P) but does not cross-reference tree species to ECM Appendix F utility-compatible list. Tree list (Sheet 32) shows tree species and sizes but locations of specific species relative to transformer pads are not dimensioned. Cannot verify whether trees within 10 lateral feet of pads or 15 feet of overhead distribution are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F 'UC' column.

applicableAreas: Shrubs and low-lying vegetation near transformers
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows vegetation zones (SOD, street yard landscaping, parking lot landscaping) but does not specify exact shrub planting locations relative to transformer pads or distinguish between access door side (requiring 10-foot clearance) and other sides (requiring 5-foot clearance). Cannot verify shrub clearance compliance.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electrical equipment
findings.comment: Root barrier details are referenced in landscape notes but specific locations and dimensions for root barriers protecting transformers are not shown on the landscape plan. Cannot verify whether trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electrical equipment have specified root barriers (4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment).

applicableAreas: Transformer pads and water utility lines
findings.comment: Utility plan shows water line routing but specific horizontal clearance dimensions between transformer pads and water lines are not dimensioned on the plans. Measurements cannot be reliably taken due to plan scale limitations and absence of explicit callouts. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from water lines.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads and wastewater lines
findings.comment: Utility plan shows wastewater line routing but specific horizontal clearance dimensions between transformer pads and wastewater lines are not dimensioned. Cannot verify minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance from wastewater service lines.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads and storm drain lines
findings.comment: Utility plan shows storm drain routing, and vision analysis indicates a storm drain line passes within approximately 5-10 feet of the central transformer. However, exact dimensions are not provided on plans. Cannot definitively verify minimum 5-foot clearance from storm drain lines.

applicableAreas: If gas service is provided to site
findings.comment: No gas utility lines are shown or referenced in the utility tap plan. Cannot verify whether gas service is present at the site or confirm clearance requirements (24 inches for <60 psi, 36 inches for ≥60 psi) if applicable.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads and other underground utilities
findings.comment: Underground utilities include water, wastewater, storm drain, underground electric, and potentially others (telecommunications, reclaimed water). Plan shows these utilities but does not provide dimensioned clearances from transformer pads. Cannot verify minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities (excluding gas, fuel, steam).

applicableAreas: Transformer pads and overlapping/underlying utilities
findings.comment: Utility plan shows utilities routing in proximity to transformer locations, but cross-section drawings showing vertical relationships (utilities directly above/below pads or buildings/foundations over AE equipment) are not provided. Cannot verify that transformers are not located over/under utility lines or that other structures are not over AE equipment.

applicableAreas: If overhead distribution lines are present near site
findings.comment: Utility plan shows 'OHE' (Overhead Electric) lines on the landscape plan but location relative to transformer pads and vertical clearance (7.5 feet sky-to-ground) are not documented. Cannot verify minimum clearance from overhead distribution line conductors.

applicableAreas: If overhead distribution primary/neutral conductors are present
findings.comment: Overhead electric distribution lines are shown on plans but conductor locations and 15-foot radius clearance zones from primary/neutral conductors are not documented. Cannot verify compliance with 15-foot radial clearance requirement.

applicableAreas: If overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas above/adjacent to transformers
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths where overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas exist. Cannot verify vertical clearance compliance where transformer access paths intersect with overhead obstructions.

applicableAreas: If oil-filled transformer equipment is proposed
findings.comment: Transformer equipment specifications (oil-filled vs. dry-type) are not provided. Grading plan shows surface drainage contours but does not explicitly demonstrate that liquid flow is directed away from transformer pads if oil-filled equipment is used. Cannot verify drainage/grading requirement without equipment specifications.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Site plan and plat show property boundaries and easements, but transformer locations relative to property lines are not dimensioned. Cannot definitively verify that all three transformer pads are 100% on private property and do not straddle property lines based on scale drawings alone.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads within or near drainage, water, sewer, or electric easements
findings.comment: Multiple easements are shown on the plat (drainage, electric, wastewater, water, utility), but specific boundaries and transformer locations relative to easements are not dimensioned. Facts.md notes critical easements not depicted on the plans (Greenbelt Access, City of Austin Drainage). Cannot verify that transformers are not located in prohibited easements without explicit confirmation and AE Design approval.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads
findings.comment: Transformer easements are not shown as distinct easement areas on site plans or electrical plan. Electrical plan notes mention easement requirements but do not show easement boundaries around pads. Cannot verify that transformer easements are properly shown or that easement width is adequate for Austin Energy accessibility.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformers to meters
findings.comment: Electrical plan shows pull boxes and underground electric routing but does not explicitly document that electrical routing from transformers to meters is 100% on private property. Cannot verify compliance without detailed routing plan and property boundary confirmation.

applicableAreas: All transformer pads
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions are not shown on electrical plan. Transformer equipment specifications (service type, single-phase vs. three-phase, KVA, voltage) are not provided. Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets are not submitted with application. Cannot verify that pad dimensions match AE Design specifications for the specified service type.
